statBlock.name: Barbed Devil
statBlock.description: An alert infernal guard covered in spikes, quick to punish a grapple or set a fleeing foe ablaze.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Barbed Hide. At the start of the devil's turn, each creature grappling it takes 5 (1d10) piercing damage.
Devil's Sight. The devil sees through magical darkness with its darkvision.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks and one Tail attack, or use Hurl Flame twice.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 10 (2d6 + 3) piercing damage.
Hurl Flame. Ranged spell attack, +5 to hit, range 150 ft., one target. Hit 10 (3d6) fire damage. A hit also ignites a flammable object that nobody is wearing or carrying.
sections.Infernal return: A devil killed outside the Nine Hells disappears in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor and re-forms immediately at full strength on its home layer. Death within the Nine Hells is permanent.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67 and 70. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Bearded Devil
statBlock.description: An infernal shock trooper that drives foes back with a saw-toothed glaive and a venomous beard.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Devil's Sight. The devil sees through magical darkness with its darkvision.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Steadfast. The devil is immune to Frightened while it can see an ally within 30 ft.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Beard attack and one Glaive attack.
Beard. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 12 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned for 1 minute and cannot regain HP while affected. At the end of each of its turns, it can repeat the save and ends the effect on a success.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage. A creature hit by the glaive makes a DC 12 Constitution save unless it is a Construct or Undead. On a failure it suffers an infernal wound that costs it 5 (1d10) HP at the start of each of its turns. Each further Glaive hit against the wounded target adds 5 (1d10) to that ongoing loss. Any creature can spend an action and pass a DC 12 Wisdom (Medicine) check to close the wound. Magical healing received by the target also closes it.
sections.Infernal return: A devil killed outside the Nine Hells disappears in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor and re-forms immediately at full strength on its home layer. Death within the Nine Hells is permanent.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67 and 70. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.

statBlock.name: Pit Fiend
statBlock.description: An infernal general with leathery wings, a flaming mace, and venom that cuts off healing.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Fear Aura. Unless the pit fiend is Incapacitated, a hostile creature starting its turn within 20 ft. of it makes a DC 21 Wisdom save. Failure leaves the creature Frightened until the start of its next turn. Success grants immunity to this pit fiend's Fear Aura for 24 hours.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Magic Weapons. The pit fiend's weapon attacks count as magical.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make one Bite, one Claw, one Mace, and one Tail attack.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 21 Constitution save. On a failure it is Poisoned, cannot regain HP, and takes 21 (6d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage.
Mace. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning plus 21 (6d6) fire damage.
Tail. Melee weapon attack, +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Infernal return: A devil killed outside the Nine Hells disappears in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor and re-forms immediately at full strength on its home layer. Death within the Nine Hells is permanent.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67 and 77. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.
sections.Innate spellcasting: Charisma is the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). These spells require no material components. At will: Detect Magic and Fireball. Three times per day each: Hold Monster and Wall of Fire.

statBlock.name: Imp
statBlock.description: A shapechanging infernal spy that can vanish with its gear and strike with a venomous sting.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that are not silvered.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. As an action, the imp can assume one of three beast forms or return to its true form. A rat walks 20 ft. A raven walks 20 ft. and flies 60 ft. A spider walks 20 ft. and climbs 20 ft. Apply the chosen form's speeds and keep the imp's other statistics. Its equipment stays as it was. Death restores its true form.
Devil's Sight. The devil sees through magical darkness with its darkvision.
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Sting (Bite in Beast Form). Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
Invisibility. The imp and its worn or carried gear become magically Invisible until it attacks or its Concentration ends, as if concentrating on a spell.
sections.Infernal return: A devil killed outside the Nine Hells disappears in sulfurous smoke or dissolves into ichor and re-forms immediately at full strength on its home layer. Death within the Nine Hells is permanent.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2014), pp. 67 and 76. Damage resistance wording follows the official errata.
